value: Twelve assignable quickslots on the D-pad: the four directions, LT + a direction and RT + a direction, each holding an item to use, a weapon to draw, an expression to perform or a spell to ready. Assign from the inventory, expressions and abilities books or from the expression wheel; the D-pad on the HUD shows what each slot holds. A direction with nothing assigned keeps the game's own use.
Four more slots, reached by holding the left trigger.
Four more slots, reached by holding the right trigger. While any of them is assigned the right trigger no longer opens the spells menu.
Show what each slot holds on the HUD's D-pad, and the held bank's slots while a trigger is down.
